decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and publicly promoted since 2018, it has high sunk investment and core fit, so escalation strongly favors persistence.
As a single distant product with limited investment and weak strategic fit, after three years disappointing results cannot be attributed to temporary causes, making exit easier.
The product line with several models signals substantial investment and visible public commitment, so escalation makes management persist despite the distant fit.
Similar to E, the multi-model line represents significant sunk costs and public commitment, leading the firm to keep it rather than write off the investment.
